title: On the record
description: Heavy redaction bars retract to reveal a short archival note.
useCase: Stage a deliberate disclosure in an editorial story or reveal hidden product details.
reducedMotion: Live reduced-motion preferences remove interpolation and decorative playback. All content and native controls remain available. Keyboard changes settle immediately.
limitations: Original demonstration content; adapt labels and state to the host product.
look: Cream paper with a slightly rotated typewriter-style monospace note, three phrases covered by heavy black redaction bars, a red rubber stamp and italic serif signature.
motion: Pressing the toggle retracts each black bar toward its left edge with scaleX over 0.55 s ease-out, staggered 60 ms per phrase; pressing again extends them back over the text.
adapt: Each bar is the `.note span:after` pseudo-element, collapsing via `scaleX(0)` from `transform-origin:left` over 0.55 s `cubic-bezier(.25,.8,.3,1)` when `data-open` flips, with `nth-of-type` delays. Wrap your phrases in `span` elements inside `note` and drive `open`.
